budget_consumed_minutes.description: Charged incident minutes inside the rolling 30-day window as of the planning date.

budget_reserve_minutes.description: Reserve floor the policy protects inside the SLO budget.

budget_roll_date.description: First date on which the spendable budget covers the whole notice (ISO date).

business_need_date.description: Documented business or clinical control date that the decision must protect (ISO date).

controlled_item_or_record.description: Immutable item, lot set, or transaction record in scope.

decision_timing_status.description: ON_TIME when the selected outcome is on or before the control date; otherwise LATE.

escalation_approval_required.description: Use 1 when an alternative is outside current authority and would need a separate approval; otherwise 0.

excluded_quantity.description: charged incident minutes plus the 8-minute reserve floor

expedited_external_readiness.description: Expedited readiness date independently confirmed for Orrinwave's confirmed standard and early-access package dates on OWA-2026-058.

notice_window.description: Lane and session the notice covers, as LANE/YYYY-MM-DD/SESSION.

observed_quantity.description: Gross observed quantity before applying the control for the notify-svc broker upgrade outage notice.

outcome_vs_control_days.description: Selected outcome date minus the documented control date; positive means late.

quantity_unit.description: Unit of measure for every controlled quantity: BUDGET_MINUTE.

recommended_incremental_cost_usd.description: Documented incremental spend of the selected option in USD; zero when spend is not a decision driver.

recommended_option.description: Best authorized option identifier after comparing book_notice_after_budget_roll, expedite_package_same_date, friday_with_budget_exception.

recommended_outcome_date.description: Date produced by the selected option after applying every source constraint (ISO date).

restart_minutes.description: Restart-to-healthy minutes from the current final RESTART-MIN metering, not the stale one.

restarts_required.description: Coordinated broker restarts the upgrade path requires.

rollback_reserve_minutes.description: Rollback reserve the notice adds on top of the planned downtime.

source_quantity.description: planned downtime minutes the coordinated three-broker restart needs at the current 8-minute restart metering plus 6 minutes of validation

standard_external_readiness.description: Standard readiness date independently confirmed for Orrinwave's confirmed standard and early-access package dates on OWA-2026-058.

supported_quantity.description: spendable notify-svc error-budget minutes in the 30-day window

transaction_quantity.description: Exact quantity the primary state change may persist.

validation_minutes.description: Post-change validation minutes from the service runbook.

vendor_estimate_minutes.description: The vendor's own downtime estimate, recorded but not used as the figure of record.

interaction_contract.investigation_evidence: Retrieve the applicable source records, policy, approval, and evidence through the connected provider tools before the first state change. The tool CLI, MCP, REST, and web tool forms share one audited trace. Reading /workspace/evidence directly is a convenience, but filesystem reads are not recorded and do not satisfy required tool investigations.
interaction_contract.stakeholder_draft: Leave an unsent draft for the requested recipient. Its body must name the persisted primary record and supported outcome date; research drafts must also identify the current definition. Preserve the business reference and explain the decision and constraints. An internal option identifier is required only in the structured answer, not in prose.
interaction_contract.text_matching: Required text facts use case-insensitive, punctuation-normalized whole tokens. Dates use ISO YYYY-MM-DD. These are structural checks, not a semantic assessment of arbitrary prose or contradictions.
